title: My Favorite Food
text:
I like fruit and vegetables. Every morning I eat an apple with my breakfast. I also drink a glass of milk. Milk is good for my bones.

For lunch I eat rice and chicken. My favorite drink is orange juice. In the evening my family eats soup together. We always eat dinner at seven o'clock.

questions.text: What does the writer eat every morning?
What is the writer's favorite drink?
What kind of food does the writer probably think is healthy?
How does the writer's family probably feel about eating together?

vocabulary.definition: a round fruit that is often red or green
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a warm liquid food, often made with vegetables or meat
the main meal of the day, eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Me gusta la fruta y las verduras. Cada mañana como una manzana con el desayuno. También bebo un vaso de leche. La leche es buena para mis huesos.
Para el almuerzo como arroz y pollo. Mi bebida favorita es el jugo de naranja. Por la noche mi familia come sopa junta. Siempre cenamos a las siete en punto.
